g.text: Left: an illustrative compression curve with the sublinear shape BPE actually exhibits — doubling the vocabulary buys steadily less.
Right: exact parameter arithmetic for an untied embedding and output head. A bigger vocabulary means fewer tokens per document
(cheaper training and inference per character) but more embedding parameters and a larger, slower softmax.
